paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Natan.
In Pesachim 115a he told Ravina: “This is what Hillel, the Amora, said on the authority of received tradition.”[^1]

notes.text: קטו. gives Pesachim 115a under the period convention, without independently checking a named edition. The heading figure is the understood speaker to Ravina; older machine לרבונא הכיא differs from supplied לרבינא הכי אמר. גמרא here is received tradition, not a finished book being quoted. The parenthetical Amora is in Hyman’s source. Both Rav titles are full; Hillel and Ravina gain no title.
